query: John Muir family 1849 Wisconsin farm Fountain Lake (allowed_domains: loc.gov, archives.gov, si.edu, sierraclub.org, pacific.edu, state.gov)
notes: Hosts: vault.sierraclub.org (7: Fountain Lake Farm page, Brief Biography, Leshuk 'Wisconsin Days', Brynildson article, fact sheet PDF, Wolfe press release), sierraclub.org (translated fact sheets), pacific.edu (Holt-Atherton John Muir Life Chronology). Checked: pacific.edu chronology (curl) says the family arrived at Fountain Lake, Wisconsin in spring 1849 but does not say they started a farm; Sierra Club vault pages (curl hit an Incapsula bot challenge; read in browser, not snapshotted) - Fountain Lake Farm page says 'a family from Scotland homesteaded 160 acres' in 1849 but names the family Muir only in a later sentence; Brief Biography says the Muir family emigrated in 1849 'settling first at Fountain Lake' without saying farm; Leshuk article splits the 1849 landing and 'Fountain Lake Farm' across sentences. No single passage from an institution other than NPS states the claim on its own, so nothing staged.
